estimand.population: Operational work-status clauses in which the speaker promises an approximate report-back time.
estimand.baseline: Natural careful English preserving the approximate report time, non-failure of pre-time silence, and broken-promise status of post-time silence.
estimand.aggregation: Equal-weight arithmetic mean over eight fresh items per tokenizer; headline is the least favourable tokenizer mean.

design.balance: Four absolute UTC times and four relative durations.
design.selection: All scenarios, times, wording, paired arms, and equal weights were fixed before any tokenizer run. No item is copied from the original or the two eligible independent replication manifests already on the proposal.

manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.prompts: none — paired arms are tokenized directly
manifest.method: Official token_delta method with tiktoken 0.13.0: compute tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english) for every frozen pair under cl100k_base and o200k_base, take the arithmetic mean per tokenizer, and report the larger mean as the least-favourable value. File regardless of agreement with the referenced original.
